translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Mak
book.title: MAK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Mak Tikak

content: Biyn Aŋgyokep Akaŋ Mer Aŋgyak
Jiysis Kapaniyam kirgiy, Jiwdiya miñmon namb okok amiy, am Joden ñiŋg tikiy, pis bindoŋ amnak. Amek, biynimb gok niŋiy, ap nan-geyak, nuk per giyiŋgip rek kuyip minim aŋgñak.
Bi Peresiy gok Jiysis yerip rek aŋgniŋgamb aŋgiy, mindek ak apiy, aŋgniŋiy aŋgyak, “Bi gok biyn diy, aŋgyokniŋg aŋgyokniŋgambay akaŋ, yerip gos niŋban?”
Aŋgeyak, Jiysis aŋgak, “Mosis minim yerip aŋgiy tikak?”
Aŋgek aŋgyak “Mosis aŋgak, ‘Biyn aŋgyokniŋg; nip aŋgyoksipiyn aŋgiy, nup ñiwkil band bap tikñiy aŋgyoknimuŋ aŋgak’ aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, Jiysis aŋgak, “Minim aŋgñey kasek ma dipim rek, Mosis minim kun ak tikak.
Pen Gor miñmon alwol gayak ñin ak, bi gay biyn gay gak.
Ar kun ak mey, bi gok nop nonim sikop yip mindiy, biyn diyiŋg kuyip kirgiy,
kiykber jimñiy kiner mumbwak nokom ayip. Gor aŋgek mumbwak nokom yimb ayniŋgamb kun ak,
bi gunap tikjakiy, kuyip aŋg tuŋgasik keykey ma ayniŋgiy aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, binuk gok yip tip ak korip miŋgan biyaŋ amiy,
nup minim kun ak tip aŋgniŋeyak aŋgak, “Bi gok biyn diy aŋgyokiy, biyn kisenimb diniŋgambay ak, tap siy tap timey giniŋgambay.
Pen biyn gok kunep bi diy kirgiy, bi kisenimb diniŋgambay ak, tap siy tap timey giniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Jiysis Ñapan Sikoy Gok Kuyip Ñin Jun Ar Ayak
Biynimb gunap, Jiysis ñapan chinup gok bilesiym gaŋ aŋgiy, dand apey, binuk gok kuyip aŋg geyak,
Jiysis kuyip pen aŋg giy aŋgak, “Ñapan sikoy gok kirgem yip ker wiyaŋ. Gor biynimb nuk diyn aŋgiy niŋimb mey kun gok rek.
Biynimb yomb gok, ñapan ŋaŋ Gor ker opay rek ma apeniŋgambay, kuyip ma diniŋgamb. Nimbip niŋind yimb aspiyn aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, ñapan ŋaŋ gok kuyip kaygiy, ñin jun ar ay aŋgak, “Gor nimbip kond mindonimuŋ aŋgak.”
Bi Tap Kuŋay Mindek Bap
Pen Jiysis amnakniŋ, bi bap puŋgrikind aŋgiy amek kiñiŋ siŋak koŋgim yimiy aŋgak, “Tiysa tep yimb! Yand yerer gen, Gor gek perper mindeniŋgayn?”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Yip yenen tiysa tep yimb apan? Biynimb bap tep yimb ma mindpay; Gor nokom mey bi tep yimb mindip.

Pen nand niŋban: Gor low anep wanjrem biyoŋ aŋgip, ‘Chip ma ñaŋgnimimb; biyn siy bi siy ma ginimimb; tap siy ma dinimimb; yesek ma aŋgnimimb; yesek yesek aŋgyiŋg biynimb gunap tap gok ma taw piliŋg dinimimb; nap nanim aŋgnimiyr rek niŋnimimb aŋgip’ aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, bi kun ak Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Tiysa. Yand ñiskoy miŋg tikiy, low kun gok niŋyiŋg mindpiyn aŋgak.”

Aŋgek, Jiysis nup wasemb ay aŋgak, “Tap nokom bap nep ma gipan. Amiy, tap nand yerip yerip mindip gok yokiy maniy diy, biynimb tap ma mindip gok kuyip ñinimin. Kun giy mey, mindrep gep nand ak mindeniŋgamb Gor miñmon biyoŋ. Apiyn rek giy apiy, yand yip taŋgonjur aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, bi kun ak tap nuk kuŋay mindek rek, simb gek gos par yimb ayiŋg amnak.
Jiysis binuk gok kuyip niŋkuskus giy aŋgak, “Biynimb tap kuŋay mindeniŋgamb gok kosyam yimb Gor biynimb nuk mindey, kuyip diy kond mindeniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, gos kuŋaynep niŋeyak, kuyip tip ak aŋgak, “Ñapan yand guniy. Gor biynimb nuk mindniŋg, kosyam yimb biynimb nuk mindeniŋgambay!
Kanj kamel gok ñiw lekpay miŋgan ak amniŋg, kasek amniŋgiy rek ayniŋgamb; biynimb maniy tap kuŋay mindip gok, kosyam yimb Gor nup gosimb niŋey, kuyip diy kond mindeniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, binuk gok wal yimb aŋgiy, pen aŋgniŋek pen aŋgniŋek giy aŋgyak, “Kun ak Gor biynimb yerip rek gok diy kond mindeniŋgamb aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, Jiysis kuyip niŋyiŋg aŋgak, “Biynimb gok key giniŋgiy rek ma ayip; Gor nep mey yerer giniŋg, ginimuŋ rek nep mindip aŋgak.”
Pen Piyta Jiysis nup aŋgak “Niŋan! Chin nand yip taŋgniŋg, tap chin gok maŋgiysek kirpun aŋgak.”
Aŋgek aŋgak, “Biynimb yip gosimb niŋiy, minim tep woŋg ak giniŋg:

tap woŋg kiyk gok kirgiy taŋgeniŋgambay ak; Gor kuyip direp yimb giniŋgamb. Kuyip kond mindek lum ar biy mindeniŋgambay ñin ak, nop, nonim, numam, nunay, ñapan, korip, tap kiyk gok kuŋay yimb mindeniŋgamb. Pen ñin gunap biynimb yikop gok, yip ker mindpay rek niŋiy kuyip timey giniŋgambay. Pen kisen Gor kuyip dand miñmon nuk amek, pernep mindeniŋgambay.
Biynimb kuŋaynep miñiy mindrep gipay gok, kisen mindrep ma giniŋgambay; biynimb kuŋaynep miñiy kosyam mindpay gok, kisen mindrep giniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Jiysis Kumiy, Tikjakniŋgayn Aŋgiy Tip Ak Aŋgak

Pen kiyk Jerusalem amyiŋg, Jiysis nind gak; binuk gok kisen giy gospar ayiŋg amniyakniŋ, biynimb kisen giy apeyak gok niŋiy pirikyak. Jiysis pen, binuk onep wimiŋgan ak kuyip poŋind gol siŋak amiy, tap nup yerip giniŋgamb ak kuyip aŋgñak.

Aŋgñiyiŋg aŋgak, “Niŋim; Jerusalem amon, Bi bap Ñinuk nup dam biyomb Gor nup simboŋgep gok sek, bi low tiysa gok sek kuyip ñeniŋgambay, nup kor giy ñaŋgbirik ayep aŋgiy, di bi Jiwda mer gok kuyip ñey,
nup aŋgjiwiy, kiñuk giy, miñ diy pikiy, dam pisnep pikayeniŋgambay kumniŋgamb. Pen ñin omiŋal nokom mindiy, tip ak tikjakniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Jemis Yip Jon Yip Biyomb Mindniŋg Gos Niŋrik
Sebediy ñinuk Jemis yip, Jon yip ñin bap ap Jiysis nup aŋgrik, “Tiysa. Chirmiŋay nip minim bap aŋgniŋniŋg gispur aŋgrik.”
Kun aŋgerik, Jiysis aŋgak, “Yip aŋgniŋniŋg gispiyr kun ak, nirip yerginim?”

Aŋgek aŋgrik, “Kisen nand Biyomb yimb mindiy, miñmon maŋgiysek kond mindeniŋgamban ñin ak, chirupmiŋay bi kond mindep aŋgiy, bap ñin yipund kind okok ken, bap ñin aŋind kind okok ken mindonjur aŋgrik.”
Kun aŋger, Jiysis nuk yiwur diniŋgamb rek aŋgiy aŋgak, “Nirmiŋay niŋrep giy ma aspiyr. Ñiŋg silik yand ñiŋniŋgayn ak nirmiŋay kunep ñiŋniŋgayr? Miker yand diniŋgayn ak kunep diniŋgayr?”
Aŋgek, “Yaw aŋgrik.” Aŋgerik, Jiysis aŋgak, “Niŋind apiyr ak pen;
ñin yipund kind ak an mindeniŋgamb, ñin aŋind kind ak an mindeniŋgamb ak yand ma aŋgniŋgayn; ak Bapiy tap nuk; nuk key niŋimb rek giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Pen Jiysis binuk onep wanjrem ak minim kun ak niŋiy, Jemis yip, Jon yip kuyip kuŋay aŋgniŋg geyak,

Jiysis kuyip maŋgiysek aŋgek apey aŋgak, “Nimb niŋbim: miñmon okok, biyomb yimb gok biyomb namb kayaŋ gok kuyip kond mindey, biyomb namb kayaŋ biyomb kayaŋ gok kuyip kond mindey, kiy pen biynimb gok kuyip kond mindpay.
Pen nimb kun ak rek ma ginimimb. Bi nimb bap biyomb mindniŋg ginimuŋ ak, biynimb gok kuyip woŋg giñinimuŋ.
Pen biyomb yimb mindniŋg ginimuŋ ak, biynimb gok kuyip monmon yimb woŋg giñinimuŋ.
Bi bap Ñinuk kunep, yip woŋg giñiyaŋ aŋgiy lum biy ma awak; biynimb Gor nup kirpay gok kuyip nen kumiy, di Gor yip jimñiy ayin aŋgiy owak aŋgak.”
Jiysis Bi Windin Koy Gak Bap Gek Windin Niŋak
Jiysis binuk gok yip miñmon Jeriykow kirgiy amniŋg, biynimb kuŋaynep yip amniyak. Bi Timiyas ñinuk Batiymeyas windin koy gek, kinjeŋ gol siŋak bisiŋg mindyiŋg, maniy tap gok nen asimb aŋg mindek.
Aŋg mindakniŋ, Jiysis bi Nasaret nimb asaw aŋgey niŋiy, nuk suk aŋgiy aŋgak, “Jiysis, Depiyt Ñinuk. Yip simb niŋan aŋgak!”
Aŋgek, biynimb gok nup aŋg giy aŋgyak, “Ma aŋgan! Kapkap mindey aŋgyak.” Kun aŋgyak ak pen, nuk kapkap ma mindek, suk yomb aŋgiy aŋgak, “Depiyt Ñinuk yip simb niŋan aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis maŋ kun siŋak apiy aŋgak, “Nup aŋgem awaŋ.” Aŋgek, biynimb gok bi windin koy anup aŋgyak, “Jiysis nip asap nen; tikjakiy gos sek winimin aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, chech parsek nuk ak tuŋgasik yokiy, Jiysis mindek ak kasek amnak.
Amek, Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Yip yergaŋ aŋgiy aswan?” Aŋgek aŋgak, “Tiysa. Windin ak tip niŋiyn aŋgiy aswiyn aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Tep. Yip gek suŋ ayniŋgamb aŋgiy gos niŋban rek, suŋ ayip nen, amnoŋ aŋgak.” Kun aŋgakniŋ, day windin yimb niŋiy, Jiysis yip amnak.
